updatePolicy: New sources are captured and curated, never automatically accepted.
Do not overwrite old release snapshots.
Revise records with explicit scope and source references; add route/citation regression examples.
Run build with a new YYYY-MM-DD.N, validate it, then advance current.json.
External source owners and historical acceptance remain unchanged.
deprecationPolicy: Keep IDs and replace contents only in a successor release; add superseded-by metadata before removing a route.

verificationInvalidation.equationMetric: Bound controls, layout, package and native spacing.
verificationInvalidation.pageTemplate: Page layout/package/native pagination; source meaning unchanged.
